initialization: Identical copies of the pinned confined checkpoint; fresh full-model Adam states
trainable_scope: All model parameters; no frozen reaction or electrolyte branches
stop_policy: Stop the affected arm on nonfinite values/gradients, invalid constitutive domain, sampled out-of-range concentration or identity/replay failure. Preserve failure; no clipping or silent retries.
decision_policy: Report each physical metric, not different raw kinetic losses as if equivalent. No automatic full run. Full acceptance still requires all unchanged independent reference/balance/PDE criteria; missing evidence is INCOMPLETE.
implementation_requirements: shared learned j in every physical term
strict source identity and paired initialization checks
scope: One warm-start feasibility pair, not the original C-F factorial study or a robustness claim
